notes.title: "Pretty Girls Tile Match" How to play!
notes.content:
How to play
The game is cleared when all tiles placed on the stage can be erased.

Basic Rules
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944470/72c5f739e65b9c18cb8fb131f0d5f00dc4262532.png
Selecting a tile moves it to your hand, and you can erase it by matching three tiles with the same pattern in your hand.
Up to 7 tiles can be held, and the game is over if the tiles cannot be erased after 7 tiles are held.
※The game will not be over if the help function can be used and the number of times it has been used remains.
Stacked tiles can be selected by removing the tiles in the upper row.

Difficulty

EASY.
There is no time limit and you can use the help function as many times as you want.
NORMAL
There is no time limit, and the number of times you can use the "help" function is limited.
HARD
There is a time limit and a limit to the number of times you can use the help function.
※When the time limit is reached, a tile is automatically added to your hand at random from the tiles available for selection.

Helpful Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944470/22da9d82bf1960352614fcbf3fbd10027ccf7827.png
[olist]
Shuffle
Mixes and rearranges all placed tiles, tiles in the hand, and tiles held in the hold.
Undo
Put back the tile you just added to your hand.
※ It cannot be undone if you have aligned and erased tiles or used other helping functions.
Move
Eliminates a tile identical to a tile in the hand or a tile chosen at random from the placed tiles.
※Added scores are not multiplied by the combo.
Hold
Keep the leftmost tile in your hand next to your hand.
If you select the retained tiles, you can add them to your hand again.
You can hold up to 3 tiles.
[/olist]
